subject.title: docs(install): add vendor-neutral NVIDIA Jetson install guide

question: Should OpenClaw core docs accept a vendor-neutral NVIDIA Jetson install guide once the JetPack setup guidance is source-backed?
rationale: VISION.md supports setup reliability but routes promotional or optional ecosystem surfaces outside core, and the linked issue explicitly asks maintainers to set the hardware-docs boundary.

options.title: Accept Vendor-Neutral Guide After Repair
options.body: Merge a source-backed Jetson install guide that avoids commercial hardware references and mirrors the Raspberry Pi guide's first-party install-doc pattern.

options.title: Route Jetson Hardware Docs Outside Core
options.body: Close or pause this PR and ask contributors to maintain Jetson-specific hardware guidance in vendor or ecosystem docs instead.

options.title: Use A Generic Edge-Hardware Page
options.body: Ask for a broader non-vendor hardware guide rather than a Jetson-specific first-party page.

recommendation.title: Accept Vendor-Neutral Guide After Repair
recommendation.body: Merge a source-backed Jetson install guide that avoids commercial hardware references and mirrors the Raspberry Pi guide's first-party install-doc pattern.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-history signal connects this contributor to docs navigation, VISION scope policy, and adjacent install docs.
